contents.name: Sections 2.4-2.10: graded module categories, the shift M<r>, induction and restriction functors, the dualities, divided powers, and the categorification of the negative half
Section 2.7 and (2.30): the contravariant graded module duality and the projective Hom-duality, both shift-reversing, and the normalized self-dual representatives
Sections 3.1-3.2: the quantized enveloping algebra, its integral form and the upper crystal conventions

contents.reason: Internal to the source's own proof of Theorem 5.3 through the crystal recursion; the library transport uses the reviewed batch-11 crystal and global-basis interfaces, so no item of this batch consumes the quasi-canonical basis.
